title: Why we're choosing stewardship over an exit
partialText: The most common path for companies like ours is to be sold. We're taking a different path. The THOUGHTBOT PURPOSE TRUST is designed to preserve our values and mission.

title: The Bike Shed Ep 503:  Seeing the Graph for the Trees

title: Announcing Shoulda Matchers 8.0: validate multiple attributes in one line
